Poultry Feed Prices Rise, Affecting Meat Retailers

Meat retailers are experiencing a negative impact due to an increase in poultry feed prices. This rise is attributed to a weak monsoon and the demand for ethanol. The effects are expected to be felt by food businesses before consumers.
